title: Takbir-i-Tahrimah
instruction: Raising both hands to the earlobes (or shoulders):
ar: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
tl: Allahu Akbar
en: Allah is the Greatest.

title: Thana'
instruction: Recited silently after folding hands on the chest:
ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
tl: Subhanakallah-humma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wala ilaha ghairuk.
en: Holy art Thou, O Allah, and all praise is Thine; blessed is Thy name, and exalted is Thy state. There is none worthy of worship except Thee alone.

title: Ta'awwudh
instruction: Recited silently before Surah Al-Fatihah:
ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
tl: A'udhu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajim.
en: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed.

title: Tasmiyah
instruction: Recited before Surah Al-Fatihah and before any subsequent chapter:
ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
tl: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim.
en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

title: Surah Al-Fatihah
instruction: Recited in every Rak'at of prayer. At the end, worshippers say 'Amin':
ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ۝ اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ۝ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ۝ مٰلِکِ یَوۡمِ الدِّیۡنِ ؕ۝ اِیَّاکَ نَعۡبُدُ وَاِیَّاکَ نَسۡتَعِیۡنُ ؕ۝ اِہۡدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الۡمُسۡتَقِیۡمَ ۙ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِیۡنَ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ ۬ۙ غَیۡرِ الۡمَغۡضُوۡبِ عَلَیۡہِمۡ وَلَا الضَّآلِّیۡنَ
tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Al-hamdu Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen. Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Maaliki yawmid-deen. Iyyaaka na'budu wa iyyaaka nasta'een. Ihdinas-siraatal-mustaqeem. Siraatal-ladheena an'amta alayhim ghayril-maghdoobi alayhim wa lad-daalleen.
en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds, The Gracious, the Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment. Thee alone do we worship and Thee alone do we implore for help. Guide us in the right path — The path of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy blessings, those who have not incurred Thy displeasure, and those who have not gone astray.
note: Concluding with: آمِين (Amin — 'O Allah! Accept our supplications.')

title: A Portion of the Holy Quran
instruction: In the first two Rak'ats, at least three short verses or a complete chapter is recited. Common examples include Surah Al-Kauthar (108), Surah Al-Ikhlas (112), Surah Al-Falaq (113), or Surah An-Nas (114).
ar: إِنَّاۤ اَعۡطَیۡنٰکَ الۡکَوۡثَرَ ؕ۝ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّکَ وَانۡحَرۡ ؕ۝ اِنَّ شَانِئَکَ ہُوَ الۡاَبۡتَرُ
tl: Innaa a'taynaakal-kawthar. Fasalli lirabbika wanhar. Inna shaani'aka huwal-abtar.
en: Surely We have given thee abundance of good; So pray to thy Lord, and offer sacrifice. Surely, it is thy enemy who is without issue.

title: Ruku' (Bowing)
instruction: Saying 'Allahu Akbar' while bowing. Recited silently at least 3 times (or odd number):
ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
tl: Subhana Rabbiyal-'Azim.
en: Holy is my Lord, the Most Great.

title: Tasmi' (Rising from Ruku')
instruction: Recited by the Imam (or individual) while rising from bowing to standing:
ar: سَمِعَ اللّٰهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
tl: Sami'allahu liman hamidah.
en: Allah listens to him who praises Him.

title: Tahmid (Praise on Standing)
instruction: Recited by worshippers upon standing erect:
ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
tl: Rabbana walakal-hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih.
en: Our Lord, Thine is the praise, the praise which is bountiful, pure and blessed.

title: Sajdah (Prostration)
instruction: Saying 'Allahu Akbar' while going down into prostration. Recited silently at least 3 times:
ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
tl: Subhana Rabbiyal-a'la.
en: Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

title: Jilsah (Between Prostrations)
instruction: Saying 'Allahu Akbar', sit upright and recite this supplication before the second prostration:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْفَعْنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
tl: Allahum-maghfir li warhamni wahdini wa 'afini warfa'ni wajburni warzuqni.
en: Lord forgive me and have mercy on me and guide me and grant me security and raise me up and make good my shortcomings and provide for me.

title: Qa'dah — Tashahhud
instruction: Sitting at the end of the second Rak'at (and final Rak'at). Raise right forefinger at 'Ashhadu alla ilaha illallah' and lower it:
ar: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
tl: Attahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibatu, Assalamu 'alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh, Assalamu 'alaina wa 'ala ibadillahis-Salihin. Ashhadu alla ilaha illallahu wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh.
en: All Salutation is due to Allah and all Prayer and everything pure. Peace be upon thee, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings; and peace be on us and on all righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

title: Durud Sharif
instruction: Invocation of blessings on the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him):
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
tl: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama sallaita 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidum-Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidum-Majid.
en: Bless, O Allah, Muhammad and the people of Muhammad, as Thou didst bless Abraham and the people of Abraham. Thou art indeed the Praiseworthy, the Glorious. Prosper, O Allah, Muhammad and the people of Muhammad, as Thou didst prosper Abraham and the people of Abraham. Thou are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

title: Prayer after Durud (a)
instruction: Recited after Durud (one or more prayers may be chosen):
ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
tl: Rabbana atina fiddunya hasanatan wa fil akhirati hasanatan waqina adhabannar.
en: Our Lord, grant us good in this world as well as good in the world to come, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

title: Prayer after Durud (b)
instruction: Supplication of Prophet Abraham (peace be upon him):
ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي، رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ، رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
tl: Rabbij'alni muqimas-Salati wamin dhur-riyyati. Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a'. Rabbanaghfir li wali-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yauma yaqumul hisab.
en: My Lord, make me observe Prayer, and my children too. Our Lord! bestow Thy grace on me and accept my prayer. Our Lord, grant forgiveness to me and to my parents and to the believers on the day when the reckoning will take place.

title: Prayer after Durud (c)
instruction: Supplication for protection against anxiety, debt and helplessness:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-huzni, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasli, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa a'udhu bika min ghalbatid-daini wa qahrir-rijal.
en: O Allah, I seek Thy protection against problems and anxieties, and I seek Thy protection against helplessness and shiftlessness, and I seek Thy protection against cowardice and miserliness, and I seek Thy protection against indebtedness and the tyranny of people.

title: Prayer after Durud (d)
instruction: Supplication taught by the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him):
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
tl: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.
en: O Allah, I have been unjust to myself and no one grants pardon for sins except You; therefore, forgive me with Your forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely You are the Forgiver, the Merciful.

title: Prayer after Durud (e)
instruction: Supplication for protection against trials and tribulations:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabri wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-masihid-dajjal. Wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram.
en: O Allah, I seek Thy protection from the punishment of the grave, and I seek Thy protection against Dajjal, the architect of disorder and trials, and I seek refuge with You from afflictions of life and death. O Allah, I seek Thy protection from sins and from being in debt.

title: Salam (Conclusion of Prayer)
posture: Sitting posture — Turning face to right, then left
instruction: Turn the face to the right, saying 'Assalamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah', then turn to the left, saying the same:
ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ
tl: Assalamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah.
en: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah.

title: Remembrance of Allah (a)
instruction: Recited by the Holy Prophet (sa) immediately after finishing Prayer:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
tl: Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salamu, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
en: O our Lord! Thou art (the embodiment of) peace. And true peace comes from Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord of Majesty and Bounty.

title: Remembrance of Allah (b)
instruction: Declaration of the Oneness and Sovereignty of Allah:
ar: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah. Lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd. Wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadir.
en: There is no one worthy of worship except Allah. He is alone and has no partner. Sovereignty and praise are only for Him and He has full authority over everything.

title: Remembrance of Allah (c)
instruction: Affirmation of Allah's Supreme will:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
tl: Allahumma la mani'a lima a'taita wala mu'tiya lima mana'ta wala yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
en: O Allah! Nobody can hold back whatever You have granted and none can grant what Thou hold back. And no great person can benefit from his greatness in opposition to Thy Greatness.

title: Remembrance of Allah (d)
instruction: Prayer for devotion and gratitude:
ar: اللّٰهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
tl: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatika.
en: O my Lord, help me so that I can properly perform Thy remembrance and Thy thanksgiving, and that I may worship Thee in the best possible manner.

title: Remembrance of Allah (e)
instruction: Praising the Lord of all the worlds:
ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tl: Subhana Rabbika Rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifun, Wa salamun 'alal-Mursalin, Wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.
en: Thy Lord is Holy and clear of all that is alleged against Him (by the non-believers); and He is Exalted. May God's blessing be upon all Messengers. All praise truly belongs to Allah Who is the Sustainer of all the worlds.

title: Tasbih Fatimah (Optional)
instruction: Recited 33 times, 33 times, and 34 times respectively:
tl: Subhanallah (33x) · Alhamdu Lillah (33x) · Allahu Akbar (34x)
en: Holy is Allah, free from all defects (33 times) · All praise belongs to Allah (33 times) · Allah is the Greatest (34 times)
